column3: The construction of the new office building starts next week. (新辦公大樓的施工將於下週開始。)
The airline had to suspend all flights due to the storm. (由於暴風雨，航空公司不得不暫停所有航班。)
My colleagues always support me when I have a big project. (當我有大型專案時，同事們總是很支持我。)
The police started an investigation into the missing laptop. (警方針對筆記型電腦失竊一事展開調查。)
You can control the room temperature with this remote. (你可以用這個遙控器來控制室溫。)
The heavy rain caused some damage to the roof. (大雨對屋頂造成了一些損害。)
This restaurant has a great reputation for fresh seafood. (這家餐廳以新鮮海鮮享有盛名。)
The company faced a big scandal after the CEO lied to investors. (在執行長對投資人撒謊後，該公司面臨了一場大醜聞。)
The jury decided the man was guilty of the crime. (陪審團判定該男子犯下了這項罪行。)
The judge will sentence the driver later this afternoon. (法官將於今天下午稍晚對該駕駛進行宣判。)
